profile.headline: Problem Solver || AI/ML Platforms || Agentic AI || Cloud Native || Automate Everything
profile.summary: "There must be a better way." Driven software engineer dedicated to streamlining workflows and leveraging AI/ML to solve complex engineering challenges.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led development of the ML Platform for AccuRhythm™ AI built on AWS Sagemaker and Kubernetes utilizing hexagonal microservices, Istio mesh with FastAPI and Kafka inputs, NoSql backend DB, Sagemaker inference with auto scaling, model monitoring, observability, CI/CD fully automated testing, environment promotion and rollback/recovery.
Directed technical vision and execution across 2 cross-functional teams (30+ engineers) spanning MLOps and Data Engineering, standardizing data pipelines and ML delivery across the organization.
Built AI agent backed by a rigorous output evaluation framework using promptfoo, guaranteeing reliable AI responses for automated, high-speed compliance reviews for regulatory documents.
AI Transformation Guiding Coalition: Selected as 1 of 5 technical leads to direct business unit AI adoption, establish best practices, and evaluate internal toolchains.
CI/CD & DevSecOps Community Leadership: Led an 80+ member cross-functional Community of Practice—hosting bi-weekly tech talks to upskill engineering teams—and organized an internal DevSecOps conference for 250+ attendees.
AI-first development: Combined AI coding tools, automated testing, and prompt engineering into daily workflows to boost velocity and raise overall code quality.

positions.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
Architected the Level2 Data Science Platform, accelerating the end-to-end lifecycle for deploying production machine learning models.

Modernized analytics infrastructure by deploying containerized Apache Airflow on GCP, replacing legacy Cron workflows.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Directed technical execution for key R&D initiatives, translating high-level business goals into actionable roadmaps and technical deliverables.
Productionized POC machine learning models, refactoring data science code into robust, scalable production frameworks.
Architected a real-time analytics pipeline using Apache Storm and Kafka to process high-throughput streaming data.
Optimized multi-GPU neural network training and inference, maximizing hardware utilization and accelerating model execution.
Led development of an automation framework that containerized and packaged 30+ open-source projects, streamlining deployment.
Championed Agile practices, improving sprint predictability, team velocity, and cross-functional alignment.

positions.title: Computer Engineer
positions.description: Evaluated foreign cyber threat intelligence to defend US Air Force systems against advanced adversaries.

positions.description: Developed Spiking Neural Network visualization library plugin for MATLAB.
